Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE SQUARE 1:1 photographic BEFORE image for an interactive jewelry cleaning comparison on a fictional artisan jeweler website. A single modest yellow gold solitaire ring, plain smooth rounded band, six-prong setting with one round colorless brilliant-cut diamond, standing upright at a three-quarter front angle on a matte warm charcoal jeweler tray. Entire ring visible with generous margins, centered, ring silhouette about 65 percent of canvas width. Honest neutral diffuse daylight, fixed camera, 85mm macro lens, detailed natural metal and stone. BEFORE condition: realistic thin buildup of skin oils and pale soap residue on the stone and under prongs dulling the diamond, fingerprints on gold, mild surface grime but no structural damage, missing prongs, bent metal, scratches that would require repair, rust or dramatic corrosion. This is cleaning and inspection, not restoration. No hands, no tools, no other jewelry, no text, logos, labels, dividing line or watermark. Do not add artificial glow or sparkle effects. We will later edit this exact image to clean the SAME ring, with camera lighting background and geometry unchanged.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied BEFORE ring photograph into its matching AFTER CLEANING AND INSPECTION photograph for a fictional jeweler website comparison slider. Change ONLY cleanliness: remove skin oil, fingerprints, soap haze and dirt from the SAME yellow gold ring and diamond, including under the prongs. Reveal clear diamond facets and clean gold reflecting the EXISTING soft light, understated natural brilliance, no starburst or fake glow. Preserve the exact silhouette, band thickness, diamond size and position, every prong and its position, the entire ring pose, perspective, camera crop, resolution, focus plane, shadow, charcoal tray texture and tone, and identical illumination and exposure. Keep minor existing wear and scratches: cleaning alone does not change geometry or erase metal wear. No repair, added stones, changed setting, changed ring angle, retouching the background, text, labels or watermark. Output one square standalone after image only.
